# Structured Data for AI Search

`structured-data-for-ai-search` · v1.0.0 · Execute · SEO, GEO & AEO
<!-- Generated by platform/scripts/generate-engine-specs.mjs from skills/structured-data-for-ai-search/spec.json and SKILL.md. Do not edit. -->

**Decision it supports:** Is the JSON-LD on this page valid, true to what the page shows, and complete for its type?

**Inputs:** The site's key page types, and for each page its JSON-LD (or full HTML) plus the visible text

**Output:** A type-per-page map, a per-page check (fix, eligibility, improve, with the source for each), corrected JSON-LD, and a re-validation plan

**Setup:**
- Install the skill: `npx skills add sarojkjha/aaj-marketing-skills --skill structured-data-for-ai-search`
- Or connect the hosted MCP server, no install: `https://aaj-engines-mcp.sarojkjha10.workers.dev/mcp`
- Or run the local MCP server: node platform/mcp/server.mjs (Node 18 or newer)
- Input schema: the comment at the top of `skills/structured-data-for-ai-search/resources/schema-check.js` (the MCP server's describe_engine shows it). Worked example: `node skills/structured-data-for-ai-search/resources/schema-check.js --demo`.
- Agents listed: Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, Windsurf, Cline. Tested and recorded: Claude Code, OpenAI Codex (Windows, ab-test-significance only).

**Acts or analyzes:** Analyzes only. The engine makes no network calls, writes no files and changes nothing in your tools; it returns text and JSON.

**Where your information goes:**

| How you run it | Where your inputs go |
|---|---|
| Skill installed in your agent, or the local MCP server | The engine runs on your machine and AAJ receives nothing. Your AI agent still sends what you give it to its model provider (Anthropic, OpenAI and so on), under your own account's terms. |
| Hosted MCP server | Your agent's model provider, as above, plus AAJ's server on Cloudflare, which receives the engine inputs over HTTPS, runs them in memory and keeps no copy. Cloudflare keeps error logs (no inputs) for up to 7 days. |

No engine needs customer names, emails or other personal data; leave them out.

**Limitations:**
- It compares markup with what readers see only when you pass html or visibleText. Without them the verdict is "Valid markup, not checked against the page", never "Ready to publish".
- It checks the markup you paste, not what a crawler receives. JSON-LD added by client-side JavaScript may never reach a crawler.
- A clean check does not promise a rich result or any effect on AI answers. Google says no special schema is needed for its AI features.
- Its rules follow Google and schema.org pages opened on 2026-10-10. Google edits those pages; re-check the source each finding cites.

**Review before acting:** Whoever owns the site confirms every price, rating, question and date in the markup appears on the live page, then re-validates the deployed URL with Google's Rich Results Test and checks the JSON-LD is in the server response.
